## I study **religion, spirituality, and psychological well-being** across adulthood.

I am a fourth-year Ph.D. student in Social Psychology at the University of Wisconsin–Madison. My research uses large-scale longitudinal data and person-centered methods to study how religious and spiritual lives relate to eudaimonic well-being, health, and aging.

[View publications](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [About me](about.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-dark}
:::
